summary_en: Momo no Ki Co. filed a correction to the public tender offer (takeover bid) initiation notice for CAPITA Inc. (TSE Standard: 7462) issued on 2026-08-14. Correction pertains to technical redefinition of share count methodology following CAPITA's 1:2 stock split (effective 2026-07-01). Not a change to tender terms under Article 27-3(2)(1) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act.
title_en: Notice regarding correction to public tender offer initiation announcement for Momo no Ki Co.
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-14, Momo no Ki Co. (the offeror) filed a notice correcting the public tender offer initiation announcement (公開買付開始公告) for CAPITA Inc. (TSE Standard Market, code 7462, the target). The tender offer itself was initiated on 2026-08-14. The correction is technical in nature and pertains to the definition of 'ownership ratio' (所有割合) in the offer documents. Specifically, the correction clarifies that CAPITA's 1-for-2 stock split, which became effective on 2026-07-01, should be referenced using "2026-07-01 as the effective date" (効力発生日) rather than the previous phrasing. The correction applies to the calculation of reference share counts: CAPITA had 4,111,000 shares issued (less 10 treasury shares) as of 2026-06-30, which after the 1:2 split became 8,222,000 shares outstanding (less 20 treasury) for a total reference base of 8,221,980 shares ex-treasury. The filing explicitly states that this correction does not constitute a change to the tender offer conditions or terms under Article 27-3(2)(1) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act.
